classdef CatalogExtension
% CatalogExtension - Extensions in the Neurodata Extensions Catalog.
%
%   Each member is an extension listed in the Neurodata Extensions Catalog
%   (https://nwb-extensions.github.io). The member name is the extension
%   name as a MATLAB identifier, and the Name property holds the extension
%   name, such as "ndx-miniscope".
%
%   nwbInstallExtension accepts these names, and MATLAB suggests them when
%   typing its first argument.
%
%   This file is generated by tools/maintenance/matnwb_createNwbInstallExtension
%   from resources/function_templates/CatalogExtension.txt. The
%   update_extension_list workflow regenerates it from the catalog.
%
%   Example:
%       names = matnwb.extension.CatalogExtension.listNames()

    properties (SetAccess = immutable)
        % Name - Name of the extension in the catalog
        Name (1,1) string
    end

    methods
        function obj = CatalogExtension(name)
            obj.Name = name;
        end
    end

    methods (Static)
        function names = listNames()
        % listNames - List the names of the extensions in the catalog.
            members = enumeration("matnwb.extension.CatalogExtension");
            names = reshape([members.Name], 1, []);
        end
    end

    enumeration
{{enumerationMembers}}
    end
end
